steps.title: Prepare Synthetic Controls
steps.instruction: Produce synthetic controls using the binary synthetic template oligonucleotide positive control for the in-house diagnostic real-time RT-PCR method using the following sequences:

steps.title: Set Up Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction for use on a Rotor-Gene 6000 / Rotor-Gene Q 5-plex (100-place rotor discs) or an ABI 7500 Fast real-time machine.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a total reaction volume of 20µL per reaction, including a 'dead volume' of usually 2 extra reactions (adjust if using a robotic dispenser).
Dispense 15µl of the reaction mix into each reaction well.
Add 5µl of template, extracted RNA, controls, or NTC (nuclease-free water) to reach a total volume of 20µl.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following satisfactory positive criteria:

substeps.instruction: Verify a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, upward curve, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Confirm a suitable level of fluorescence intensity compared to a positive control.
Ensure a defined threshold (CT) value has been clearly exceeded early in the log-linear phase.
Confirm that results beyond 40 cycles are considered negative.
Verify that NTCs do not produce a curve.
